title: Rewrite DST test for the R3 export fix
description: tests/migrate/test_guide_regulars.py::test_dst_caveat_on_the_page_holds is red on OpenSSH 9.6: it asserts the old 'TZ=UTC' caveat and that verify-tag fails under DST. Commit 5c5008c (R3, Mark's ruling) deliberately added +1h valid-before slack and removed the caveat from docs/guide-regulars.md. Rewrite the test to check the page's new claim with real ssh-keygen/git under a DST TZ: a tag signed seconds before retirement verifies. This tracks a deliberate design change, not a weakening; keep it skipping on non-9.6 OpenSSH only if the bug cannot reproduce there, and keep a case proving the old failure would occur without the slack (e.g. the export without +1h).
acceptance_criteria: Test asserts R3's claim against real OpenSSH 9.6 under DST and would fail if the +1h slack were removed (mutation check); full tests/migrate green on 3.12 and 3.9.
